label: D1 after a reward, early-to-mid episode, mostly after an a2 choice
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 when the reward input is 1 (D1 & in_rew==1 covers 93% of activation mass, 88% recall, but only 12% precision). It never fires at GO; a small D2 share (7% of mass) comes mostly from reaching S1, often via a rare a2 transition. Firing is strongly restricted to early-to-mid episode (ep_trial < 50 holds ~97% of mass; nearly silent after trial 70) and favours trials where the previous choice was a2 (72% of mass, and good=S2 / episodes that start with S2 good). Active steps sit in a narrow band of the value head (7.54-7.73 holds 82% of mass) and of mildly a2-leaning policy logits. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables: D1, rewarded, ep_trial<50, previous choice not a1 (dev F1 0.49, mass recall 0.87). Precision stays low, so most rewarded early-episode D1 steps after a2 do not activate it; the activations are tiny in absolute terms and their magnitude was not characterised further.
